notes: Purchasing-document header, mirroring the sales_orders_header/journal_entries_header conventions: the legacy Purchase_Order_ID is carried verbatim as EBELN (a real load assigns EBELN from a number range), header totals are dropped as derived (sum of EKPO items), and workflow/status columns are dropped as structural. BSTYP='F' and BSART='NB' are the standard delivered purchase-order category/type rather than a site-specific customizing value -- flag for confirmation if the target system uses custom document types.

fields.sap_description: Purchasing Document Number (staging key, matches EKPO/EKET lines)
Purchasing Document Type (NB = standard PO, delivered default)
Vendor (staging key, odd series Vendor_ID x 2 + 1, resolves against vendors_core LFA1/LIFNR)

dropped_fields.reason: external document number; the staging key carries Purchase_Order_ID, a real load assigns EBELN from a number range -- same convention as BELNR/VBELN
derived -- a PO's value is the sum of its EKPO item net values, same treatment as journal-entry Debit_Total/Credit_Total
derived -- tax is calculated per item (EKPO-MWSKZ / condition records), not stored on the header
derived -- sum of EKPO net values plus tax conditions
the real per-item delivery dates live on the schedule lines (EKET-EINDT, populated by purchase_order_lines.json from Expected_Date); the header-level date is redundant denormalization

EKKO has no address field -- a delivery address is a ship-to partner/address-management assignment (ADRC linked via the partner function), not a header column; model when partner functions are configured
PO header long text lives in the text system (STXH/STXL, object EKKO), not a table field

structural in SAP -- release status is EKKO release procedure fields (FRGKE/FRGZU) and procurement status (PROCSTAT), both driven by workflow events, not a carried-over flat value; same treatment as Sales Orders Status
document-flow link to a purchase requisition (EBAN) -- purchase requisitions are not yet migrated (see legacy_to_sap_mapping); encode the link once that side exists
approval is rebuilt via SAP release workflow configuration, not carried as a flat field

not_migrated_fields.reason: captured by the release workflow as the releasing SAP user
captured automatically as the creating SAP user
